The health care industry is faced with constant challenges that require leaders who can blend clinical knowledge with management skills to improve the patient experience while maximizing results for health care organizations. Nova Southeastern University’s Bachelor of Science in Business Administration in Business of Health prepares students to become agents of change. This program provides the knowledge, tools, and experiences needed to develop innovative approaches to successfully tackle these challenges.

The days of following the traditional path to medical school are over. In fact, a unique major can set students apart in a competitive pool of applicants. Nova Southeastern University Bachelor of Science in Business Administration - Business of Health is designed as a pre-med program, and can help students prepare for the Medical College Admissions Test (MCAT). In addition, as a part of the H. Wayne Huizenga College of Business and Entrepreneurship, this program teaches a strong foundation in healthcare business, preparing students for a number of top-earning careers in healthcare.
60td:
Nova Southeastern University’s Bachelors of Science in Computer Science program students will explore algorithms, software design and development and take on real-world challenges.

Nova Southeastern University prepares students for a range of potential career paths. They can go beyond coding to gain expertise on data structures, algorithms, architecture, database and information retrieval, human-computer interaction, numeral and symbolic computation, operating systems, programming languages and software methodology and engineering. They will also work on practical projects and be challenged to bridge the gap between hardware and software issues. Upon completion of the program, students will have the skills every business and organization needs from a computing professional.

The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science program is accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission (CAC) of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (ABET).
60u4:
Technology is a part of every industry—in government and in public and private sectors. It drives our everyday lives. Nova Southeastern University’s Bachelor of Science - Information Technology (IT) prepares students for in-demand careers in technology. They will develop skills in programming, web development, network security, database management and human-computer interaction, giving them a wide variety of career options upon graduation.

Nova Southeastern University Information Technology curriculum is designed to increase confidence in math and technical fundamentals. Hands-on learning will help build skills and understanding of critical theoretical concepts including the structure and operation of computers. From multimedia design to cybersecurity, courses will touch upon all the prominent areas of technology. At the end of the program, they will be ready to take on an independent or faculty-guided project, or an internship in information technology.

Nova Southeastern University curriculum is designed to help students with hiring, managing, and retaining talent; optimizing operations; growing a client base; marketing; technology acquisition and implementation; controlling cost; and improving quality. The university's faculty members will tap into their thorough experience outside the classroom to ensure that students' learning experiences are practical, useful, and powerful.

Master of Science - Professional Practice Management program has two tracks:

  • general professional practices such as law, accounting, architecture, or engineering; and
  • health/medical practices such as medical, dental, psychology, or optometry. Upon completion of this program, students will possess the skills necessary to manage and operate professional practices, make informed values-based decisions, and advance their professional careers.
610t: The Nova Southeastern University Master of Business Administration with a major in Business Flex delivers exactly what students need to achieve their goals. Students will learn from professors with the real-world success they seek, and make connections through high profile internships, facility visits, guest lectures, network opportunities, and more.
